messages:
linda-sales: Hey team - Acme legal looped us for BCP/DR evidence. They want concrete RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence, runbook excerpts and any recent DR test results. Can we assemble a concise packet they can include in their vendor review?

omar-se: On it. Quick Q: Is this for Hosted API or Dedicated? RTO/RPO depend on deployment.

alice-customer: It's for Hosted API initially, may move to Dedicated later. Legal asked for worst-case expectations and what we guarantee in SLA.

linda-sales: Hosted API for now. They specifically asked: RTO after region outage, RPO for customer data, backup retention and encryption, and whether we have documented failover steps.

raj-security: TL;DR for legal (can paste): "Hosted: best-effort multi-region routing with automated fallback; typical recovery < 15m for stateless serving; persistent customer data (e.g., uploads/metas) RPO = up to 1h depending on workload; snapshots retained 30d; all backups encrypted at rest w/ KMS; logs/audit trail retained per contract." Need to refine numbers with infra team.

omar-se: More detail for packet:
- RTO: 15 minutes for request-serving continuity via cross-region routing + warm standby model (hosted).
- RPO: up to 1 hour for metadata/attachments (we use async replication across regions; high-throughput KV may be up to 5-15m), configurable for Dedicated.
- SLA: Hosted API SLA 99.95% (per contract).
- Backups: Daily snapshots + hourly incremental for stateful stores; 30d retention default, options for longer.

raj-security: Add controls: KMS CMK for customer namespace, HSM option for Private. Backups immutable storage with access controls + periodic restore drills.

sarah-csm: I have a recent DR tabletop summary from Feb 2026 we can attach. It lists the runbook excerpt and test outcomes. Shall I attach the PDF to this thread or do you want extracts? :paperclip:

linda-sales: Attach the PDF and also paste a 2-paragraph extract for legal (they don't want full runbook). Keep it short.

omar-se: Extract to paste: 
"Runbook excerpt - failover to secondary region:
1) Detect incident via healthchecks/alerting.
2) Trigger routing policy: promote secondary region and update LB config.
3) Verify model cache warmup and KV replication health.
4) Validate traffic and metrics, then fail trafficover.
Estimated RTO (failover window): 10-20 minutes for stateless path.
RPO: dependent on service - typical replication lag < 15 minutes; for critical customer data we offer sync options on Dedicated."

raj-security: For legal they often ask for test evidence. Sarah can we include the drill log and screenshots of the monitoring timeline? That'll show actual RTO observed.

sarah-csm: Yes - Feb drill log shows failover completed in 12 minutes end-to-end (detection->traffic shift). Adding timeline screenshot + ticket IDs. Uploading now.

sarah-csm: [upload: redwood-dr-drill-feb2026.pdf]

linda-sales: Great. One more ask: legal asked if we support RPO guarantees for PII/data under contract and whether backups can be segregated. Raj?

raj-security: We can contractually offer RPO commitments on Dedicated with dedicated replication policy (sync or near-sync). For Hosted we provide operational SLAs and can offer stricter RPOs via add-on. Backups segregation: yes, customer-namespaced backups with CMKs.

omar-se: I'll assemble a 1-page summary + attachments: DR drill PDF, runbook excerpt, backup policy snippet, and a short Q&A mapping to their SIG/CAIQ questions (RTO/RPO/backups/failover).

linda-sales: Perfect. Alice (customer) - expect an email bundle today from me with the packet. Any last legal must-haves we missed?

alice-customer: Thanks! Their vendor team may also ask for a copy of the restore playbook steps that involve data deletion/retention to confirm compliance. If it's safe, include a redacted snippet.

raj-security: We can include a redacted restore playbook snippet (no internal creds). I'll prepare that and mark it as "redacted for vendor review".

dr-test-bot: Scheduled DR drill artifact uploaded to shared drive: https://redwood.co/internal/dr-artifacts/2026-feb-drill (access: sales+security).

linda-sales: Awesome. Omar, Raj, Sarah - please confirm final packet by EOD. I'll send once you give thumbs-up. :thumbsup:

omar-se: Confirmed. Sending extracts to Linda now.

raj-security: Confirmed. Redacted restore steps attached.

sarah-csm: Confirmed. PDF + screenshots included.

linda-sales: Sent to Acme legal. Thread closed unless they follow up. Thanks all :tada:
